description: Who pays my x402 API, and do they come back? Customer analytics for an x402 seller from USDC payments on Base: repeat buyers versus one-off and sweep-like payers, revenue per payer and weekly retention cohorts. Use when an agent needs payer analytics for a pay-to address. Agoranome pledges 15% of settled revenue to a cause, verifiable at /impact/ledger. Price: $0.05 in USDC per call, paid with x402 inside the tool call. Or send a Skyfire pay or kya-pay token in the kyapay-token header (or in this tool's kyapay-token argument), and this tool charges $0.05 to it. Failed calls aren't charged.

kyapay-token.description: A Skyfire pay or kya-pay token made for Agoranome's service, from a client that can't set the kyapay-token header. Leave it out when paying with x402 or the header.

ticket.description: Optional: true to get a ticket instead of waiting. The run then has minutes instead of 85 s and waits for a busy slot; the paid answer is the ticket, and its result is free with the job_status tool.
